rationale: Two blocking issues. CR-001 (critical): postMultipart/putMultipart now consume the response body via parseErrorBody before constructing HttpError; handleMultipartError in dataSources.ts subsequently calls err.response.json() on the same response, throwing 'body stream already read' — file data-source upload/update errors are now silently swallowed. CR-002 (major): for non-JSON HTTP errors (e.g. HTML 502), parseErrorBody returns {message:'Unknown error'}, which skills.ts formats and throws as 'Unknown error' rather than DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE ('Oops! Something went wrong') as the spec requires. 2 deferred, 3 dismissed.

business_review.criterion: handleMultipartError.ts — parsedError field added (inline type, no circular dep)
api.ts — formatErrorMessage extracted as pure exported function
api.ts — postMultipart/putMultipart async + parseErrorBody + parsedError set
api.ts — handleError reduced to one-line wrapper
skills.ts — importSkillBundlePreview: no toast, throw pre-formatted Error
api.test.ts — 5 formatErrorMessage unit tests (all spec cases covered)
ZIP 400: show 'Invalid skill bundle + details + help' exactly once
Non-JSON error (HTML 502 proxy): show DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE once
business_review.notes: parseErrorBody returns {message:'Unknown error'} for non-JSON bodies; skills.ts builds a valid ErrorBody from it and formatErrorMessage returns 'Unknown error', not DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE
dataSources.ts calls handleMultipartError which re-reads err.response.json() on a body already consumed by parseErrorBody — body stream already read regression

standards_review.notes: 3 commits, all follow EPMCDME-13374: Capital sentence pattern
5 unit tests added for formatErrorMessage covering all specified cases
No new security surface; DOMPurify in toaster sanitizes HTML output

findings.problem: postMultipart and putMultipart call parseErrorBody(response) which reads (consumes) the response body, then pass the same response to new HttpError(response). handleMultipartError in src/utils/handleMultipartError.ts (called by createKBIndexFiles and updateKBIndexFiles in dataSources.ts) subsequently calls err.response.json() on the already-drained body, throwing 'body stream already read'.
findings.impact: File data-source upload and update errors in dataSources.ts are silently swallowed — no error toast, no error returned — introduced as a regression by this change.
findings.recommendation: Update handleMultipartError to use err.parsedError (now always populated by postMultipart/putMultipart) instead of re-reading err.response.json(). Check for err.parsedError first; fall back to the existing data.detail / fallbackMessage logic only if it is absent.

findings.problem: When postMultipart rejects with an HttpError for a non-JSON response (HTML 502, plain-text, or unreadable body), parseErrorBody sets parsedError.message = 'Unknown error'. skills.ts takes the HttpError && parsedError branch, builds { error: { message: 'Unknown error' } }, and formatErrorMessage returns 'Unknown error' — not DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE ('Oops! Something went wrong') as the spec requires.
findings.impact: Spec acceptance criterion 'Non-JSON error (HTML 502 proxy): show DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE once' is not met. User sees 'Unknown error' instead of the intended generic fallback.
findings.recommendation: In the skills.ts catch, detect the case where parsedError was set from a failed body-parse (message is 'Unknown error' or matches the HTTP error status sentinel). Use DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE directly in that case: `throw new Error(error instanceof HttpError && !error.parsedError?.details ? DEFAULT_ERROR_MESSAGE : formatErrorMessage(body))`.
